item.title: Eddie Bauer Retail Initiates Chapter 11 Process, Seeks Buyer
item.description: Eddie Bauer's retail operator will begin liquidation sales at its more than 180 locations in Canada and the U.S. and wind down some stores as it looks for a buyer.
